Aviso de Privacidad of a Mexican private-sector broker (Power Broker franchise), 3 pp. A private-sector notice was chosen deliberately: it cites the decisive 'Ley Federal de Proteccion de Datos Personales en Posesion de los Particulares', whereas a government aviso would cite the LGPDPPSO instead and would not fire the anchor. Policy document - it describes data categories collected, it contains no actual person's data.

NON-PDF specimen for the multi-format ingestion work this round. The Wolfsberg Group's OWN blank CBDDQ v1.4 workbook, straight from the standard-setter's asset host - the authoritative form, not a bank's rendering of it. Blank, so no institution or person data.

The same blank CBDDQ v1.4 as published by the Wolfsberg Group in PDF - the XLSX/PDF pair over identical content is the controlled comparison for multi-format ingestion. The OECD's own blank Entity Self-Certification form for the Common Reporting Standard, 12 pp - the standard-setter's template that bank forms are derived from. Blank: field labels only, no account holder or controlling person data.

Blank combined CRS + FATCA IGA Entity Self-Certification form published by J.P. Morgan - a bank's own adaptation, different layout and section numbering from the OECD template, which is the point of the pair. Blank, no personal data.

Blank UBO + NPO Declaration Form from HSBC Asset Management India, 4 pp - a second, very differently structured UBO form (Indian mutual-fund KYC framing, SMO fallback wording) against the European payments-acquirer form. Blank, no personal data.
